description:
### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord:** Fixed "Waiting for network..." latching until force-kill on mobile: armed NetInfo's built-in reachability probe loop (5s retries while unreachable) instead of passively mirroring the OS connectivity flag, so Discord dismisses the disconnected state itself and resumes the gateway and message fetching

patches.name: Aggressive network recovery
patches.description: Discord actively probes the network every few seconds instead of latching an offline state until force-killed (fixes stuck "Waiting for network..." on mobile).

patches.name: Hide blocked or ignored message rows
patches.description: Hides messages from blocked and ignored users entirely - no content, no divider.

patches.name: Hide gift button
patches.description: Hides the gift button in the chat message composer.

patches.name: Hide quest promo banner
patches.description: Hides the quest promo banner at the top of the server channel list.

patches.name: Pin app to built-in bundle
patches.description: Forces Discord to always run the bundle inside the APK and ignore downloaded (OTA) updates, which would otherwise silently undo the other patches. Turn this off (or update the APK) to receive official updates.
